name: JPEG-to-JPEG-CLEAN-LARGE
note: A big JPEG - a photo, a scan, a wallpaper or a wall of box art - cleaned of its JPEG blocks and ringing (1x-NMKD-Jaywreck3-Lite), then enlarged 2x with crisp edges (2x-AnimeSharpV4-Fast-RCAN-PU). All on the render server, so any size is quick. For pixel art that should come back as flat palette colours, use JPEG-to-PIXEL-ART instead. Keeps your LAB input: press 🔍 upscale.
